summary: Iteration 10 verified the core fix: Scanner alerts now feed the Auto-Trade Bot regardless of whether the bot is started. Backend pytest 11/11 passed (2 new tests: alerts-feeding-while-disabled, volume-gate-blocks). Frontend: enabling alert-threshold-50 on 1s timeframe with bot OFF flipped alertsFeeding to True within 1.5s and BotPanel bot-feed rendered 'feeding' (previously was 'no alerts' — regression is gone). Starting the bot with minVolume $5M kept alertsFeeding true and bot active=true; over ~21s no SIM positions opened during the observation window (streak of 2 same-direction alerts within 1s for a $5M+ token did not trigger — this is data-dependent, not a bug). Raising minVolume to $900M kept feed 'feeding' with 0 positions (volume gate verified). Regression spot checks: scanner table rendering, header stats, live toasts, pressure filter (All/Buying/Selling), Vol/Flip/Algo/Log buttons all still visible & working. Cleanup: close-all + config {enabled:false,dryRun:true,minVolumeUsd:5_000_000}; final backend state: enabled=false, dryRun=true, openPositions=0, keysConfigured=true (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner.jsx line 335-336: signals are POSTed unconditionally when botSignals.length>0 — matches the intended fix. Payload includes {symbol,side,price,volume} so backend volume gate works.

handle_signal correctly requires symbol in STATE['latest'] AND volume>=cfg.minVolumeUsd AND streak within 1.5s. Signals from disabled bot only update lastSignalTs (alertsFeeding) — no position side-effects. Good.

POST /api/bot/signal still accepts arbitrary symbol/price/volume with no server-side sanity vs STATE['latest'] for the volume field — a client can spoof volume to bypass the gate. SIM-only impact; consider using STATE['latest'][sym]['quoteVol'] instead of trusting client volume.

Bot may sit idle for long periods at minVolume=$5M even with alerts feeding because the streak requires two same-symbol, same-side alerts within 1.5s from the 1s poll — realistic on volatile majors but not guaranteed. Documented behaviour; not a bug.
test_credentials: n/a (no auth). Binance keys are configured; SIM/dryRun enforced.
seed_data_creation: None. bot_config left safe: enabled=false, dryRun=true, minVolumeUsd=5_000_000, positions=[].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bot is signal-driven. Scanner.jsx POSTs to /api/bot/signal on every poll whenever any dashboard alert produced botSignals — independent of bot power. Test the feed by: 1) enable alert-threshold-50 + timeframe-btn-1s, 2) GET /api/bot/status -> alertsFeeding should flip true within a poll cycle (~1.5s), bot-feed testid text becomes 'feeding'. To force a SIM trade in backend tests, POST /api/bot/signal with volume >= minVolumeUsd twice for a symbol present in STATE['latest'] (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT are always tracked). Always cleanup close-all + config enabled=false at end.
rca of the issue: Previous scanner code only POSTed botSignals when botRunning=true, so the bot's alertsFeeding flag stayed false and the UI showed 'no alerts' unless the user pressed Start. Fix (Scanner.jsx L335-336) removes the botRunning gate so every alert threshold crossing pushes to /api/bot/signal; backend sets lastSignalTs regardless of enabled state (alertsFeeding=true when lastSignalTs within 6s). Trading itself remains gated by enabled + minVolumeUsd + streak inside handle_signal, preserving safety.
